cohort: Women and their partners living in one Swedish county
finding: A negative birth experience is associated with obstetric factors such as emergency cesarean section and negative feelings during birth, with the content of these feelings differing between women and men.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was strongly associated with negative birth experiences for both women (OR 4.7, 95% CI 2.0-10.8) and men (OR 4.5, 95% CI 1.4-17.3).
